notes.title: The brand-new "LoreFold" feature is now online!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce a major update to the game—the brand-new built-in encyclopedia system, "LoreFold", is officially live! This ancient artifact embodies the wisdom of the Three Realms and will provide you with a comprehensive game guide to help you effortlessly explore this adventure-filled martial arts world.

✨ Key Features ✨

- The "LoreFold" system offers an introduction to the basics of the game, enabling new players to quickly get started and familiarize themselves with the core gameplay.

- A culinary recipe guide is also included, allowing you to easily look up the materials and steps needed to create delicious dishes, improving your survival capabilities.

- Additionally, resource distribution information is available to help players locate the resources they need with ease.

- The system also provides detailed descriptions of the special attributes of different terrains, helping you better understand how terrain affects game strategies.

We believe the "LoreFold" feature will become an indispensable assistant during your gameplay.

At the same time, we eagerly look forward to your feedback and suggestions to help us further refine and enhance the game together!

notes.title: 重大更新!!! 迁移文档文件!!!
notes.content:
[b]First of all, I would like to sincerely apologize to all the heroes![/b]

Recently, issues such as "unable to save the game," "loss of game items," and "various strange errors" are highly likely caused by the original save system, which resulted in save files not being saved successfully.

I did not discover this issue before the release. Various feedback and my own testing did not reveal any unstable errors, which turned out to be caused by the save system.

As a result, this major problem occurred after the release! I feel very regretful, and I want to apologize to all the heroes!

After several days of fixing, we have now successfully transferred the game save files from the "registry" to the "game root directory."

This way, saved files will not mysteriously disappear.

Furthermore, if no unexpected issues arise, future updates will soon enable support for the "cloud save" feature!

Version 1.2.0.0 includes the following changes.
✔✔✔✔✔✔✔
Compensation for old saves:
1.  General amnesty (clear all prison time)
2.  Sage's Spirit (reputation reaches 100)
3.  Compensation elixirs (additional 100 collectible elpirs for the Knight Union)
4.  Revive all permanently dead characters
5.  Add 200 years of lifespan to the original basis
✔✔✔✔✔✔✔
✔ Restore all perspective scaling issues.
✔ Change "Save and Exit" button to "Exit Only."
✔ The "Herbalist" buff for monsters now has its trigger chance reduced to 1%.
✔ The extra experience boost from the "Full Armament" buff increased from 15% to 50%.
✔ Fix the triggering error for the "Long Journey" achievement.
✔ Fix the error of non-residents binding coordinates for free.
✔ Significantly increase the drop probability of "Soulfire-Seed" from ghostly flames.

SORRY!!!!!!!

notes.title: Major Update (2025/1/16)
notes.content:
The game’s save system has been completely transferred from the registry to the game directory! (Future versions will support cloud saves)

In recent days, issues such as save file loss and item loss have caused a poor gaming experience for everyone.

I would like to sincerely apologize to all players for this!

I truly did not anticipate that the built-in save system of the development software would have such significant issues!

I am very regretful that this problem was not resolved during the beta testing phase!

In the upcoming updates, in addition to fixing bugs, I will continue to update new content!

notes.title: 📅 New Release Date: January 10, 2025
notes.content:
Dear friends,

We are very sorry to inform you that we have decided to postpone the release of the game, and here are the reasons:

1. We need to fix the newly discovered critical bugs.
2. The number of wishlists accumulated is not enough at the moment, and we will be doing some promotion during this period.
3. In order to avoid the two Steam sales events in December.

📅 New Release Date: January 10, 2025
On this day, we will present to you a more stable and richer gaming experience.

🎉 Test Version Invitation: Steam Playtest
Since the trial version of the game does not fully reflect the core gameplay, and we also want to collect some player feedback, we plan to launch the complete version of the game for testing from November to December - Steam Playtest. We will inform you of the specific player testing open time through announcements later. If you are interested in becoming a test player, remember to join us then!

💌 Thank you for your patience 💌
We understand that this delay may disappoint some players who have been looking forward to the game, but we assure you that every wait is for the sake of bringing you a better gaming experience. Thank you for every player's understanding and support; your enthusiasm is our driving force.

Please keep a close eye on our official announcements, where we will timely update you on the relevant information about the test version.
